response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes), station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT s.observstation, s.station_avg AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.station_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference_above_overall FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.station_avg > o.overall_avg ORDER BY difference_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10;
